title: Catalog entry
description: One cause of the fault catalog, as the manual declares it and as the export writes it into the causes array of a catalog document. It is not an MQTT message and carries no envelope: retrieval hands it to the decision backend, init writes it to app.catalog_causes and the evaluation harness reads it as the reference answer.

entry_condition.title: Entry condition
entry_condition.description: A symptom this cause explains, with how often it is the explanation.

title.description: The condition title from the manual.

likelihood.description: How often this cause explains that condition.

note.description: What distinguishes this cause from the others under the same condition.

alarms.description: Controller alarm codes the condition raises; may be empty.

name.description: The cause name shown on tickets.

benign.description: True when the cause is normal operation rather than a defect.

summary.description: What happens and why, in a paragraph.

signal_moves.description: The movements the manual expects from this cause, in the signal-move vocabulary.

signal_moves_text.description: The same movements as rendered sentences. Empty for entries derived from the PDF rather than from the manual source.

checks.description: What to check, in the order the manual gives.

parts.description: Spare part ids the remedy needs.

maintenance.description: Maintenance task ids that prevent or detect the cause.

related_alarms.description: Every alarm code any of the conditions raises.

pages.description: Where the entry appears in each built variant of the manual.

source.description: Where the entry came from: the manual's fault tables, the extraction model, or the manual source YAML.
